summary.text: Margaret Price is the Democratic candidate for the Tennessee House of Representatives, District 83, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, her campaign said she was born in Memphis and raised in District 83 and has worked with nonprofits.

paragraphs.text: Margaret Price's Ballotpedia survey response describes her as a mother, worker and neighbor who has spent her career helping communities access opportunity through work with international and national nonprofits and with local businesses and government.
She listed her campaign priorities as education and opportunity, community infrastructure and smart growth, and good governance and accountability.
She named education, workers' rights, health care and caregiving reform, and governance accountability as her policy interests.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for District 83 on August 6, 2026.
